validation.calibration: Two-generation MG1655 control, finite outputs and <=4 GiB peak RSS before batch dispatch.
validation.controls_policy: Controls must pass in the same runtime/batch. Control failure makes the batch inconclusive pending operational diagnosis, not evidence of candidate nonviability.
validation.deduplication: Validate identical genotypes once per runtime/batch and map to every originating search. Shared trajectories are not independent observations.
validation.numerical_policy: Use the existing strict v2 numerical patch uniformly. Unchanged LP/objective/constraints/tolerances; accept fallback only with identical LP, GLP_OPT and finite KKT relative residuals <=1e-7; latch failure against outer retries. Record every assisted cell.
validation.primary_endpoint: A further-reduced nominated genome reaches 20 generations in all three seeds with exact-knockout, finite-output and numerical-policy checks. Denominator includes all five assigned searches per method.
